name: Dack Fayden, Helping Hand
oracle_text: When Dack Fayden enters, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X creature cards, where X is the number of opponents you have. Put those creature cards onto the battlefield, then shuffle. They're goaded for the rest of the game. For each of those permanents, choose a different opponent. Each opponent gains control of the permanent for which they were chosen.
blocked_sentences: When Dack Fayden enters, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X creature cards, where X is the number of opponents you have.
They're goaded for the rest of the game.

needs.what: a goad that never expires: a `duration: "permanent"` ("for the rest of the game") option on the goad op, so the goaded_by mark is not cleared at the goader's next untap step
needs.why_existing_wont_do: goad takes only objects and player, and goad_creature's mark is cleared in turn._untap_step when the goading player untaps, so it lasts only until your next turn

needs.what: reveal_until with an amount: keep revealing until N matching cards (N a value, here the number of opponents) are revealed, move all N to the destination, then shuffle the rest into the library and bind the moved cards for later effects
needs.why_existing_wont_do: reveal_until stops at the first match and bottoms the rest; wrapping it in repeat would bottom per iteration rather than reveal one run and shuffle, and leaves no binding of the set of creatures put onto the battlefield

needs.what: for each of a set of permanents, choose a different opponent, and each opponent gains control (permanently) of the permanent chosen for them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: gain_control gives a whole selector to one player and rotate_control passes in a seat direction; nothing pairs each object with a distinct chosen opponent
